page.overview:
Who is Abyss?

Ex Nihila (sister, deceased); Ex Nihili (brother, deceased)

When the Builders waged war on the universe, Abyss and Ex Nihilo, along with fellow Builder systems Starbrand and Nightmask, joined the Avengers and helped them defeat their former masters. However, the Builders only attacked because the universe was dying and the Multiverse was collapsing due to the incursions. Unable to fix the decay, Abyss and Ex Nihilo joined Sunspot's Multiversal Avengers to traverse the Multiverse and figure out the cause of the collapse. In the end, they found those responsible, and Abyss and Ex Nihilo sacrificed themselves in a confrontation with the enemy, the Beyonders.

This specimen was an Abyss, carried as an egg along with her brother, the Gardener Ex Nihilo, by an Aleph, who taught them to transform any species they encountered into perfect creatures. That was to accomplish their purpose, which was to transform the universe into a perfect vision of the Builders. As an Abyss, she judged the work of the other two. One of the species they helped evolve was the Shi'ar.

Eventually, the Builders created the newuniversal superstructure, replacing the Gardeners with new Builder systems, such as Starbrands, Nightmasks, Justices, and Ciphers. Most of the Gardeners were recalled, but Ex Nihilo continued making Gardens. As the other Abyssi became obsolete, they died out, and this Abyss became the last one.
